g.title: OX57_Atomic_Install
g.text: OX-57 · Install one validated local pack atomically

g.title: local
g.text: An adapter supplies the local file

g.title: q_source
g.text: A visible in-app picker would need revised scope

g.title: rejected
g.text: no stage write or catalog change

g.title: unchanged
g.text: Before commit, any rejection, limit failure,
write failure or interruption leaves the prior
valid packId generation/catalog entry and active
scene unchanged; weather facts/time stay unchanged

g.title: limits
g.text: finite extraction entry count, expanded bytes,

g.title: q_meta
g.text: App-owned display name and opaque content/release
version are supplied separately from the closed
OX-30 manifest and OX-54 content identity.

g.title: stage
g.text: to a private, unpublished staging generation
confine every output beneath its pack root

g.title: q_budget
g.text: and staging limits; OX-91 validation limits

g.title: ready
g.text: No catalog entry points here yet

g.title: commit
g.text: record only after the staged generation is complete

g.title: catalog
g.text: entry as selectable after OX-91 acceptance

g.title: later
g.text: OX-55 still gates actual decode/load; OX-32 owns switching.
OX-57 adds no UI or weather mutation.

g.title: q_compat
g.text: Proposed: OX-91 acceptance marks the catalog
entry compatible; OX-55 still gates decode/load
